name: Axis-Aligned Clipping
definition: Hides portions of a 3D scene by defining up to six axis-aligned clipping planes (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax) to expose interior geometry.
summary: Axis-Aligned Clipping hides 3D scene portions using up to six axis-aligned planes, differing from general clipping by restricting orientations to coordinate axes to simplify intersection logic.
